text: Which transcription factors are expressed in only a handful of tissues, more than one but well under a third?
plan: Protein class: Transcription factors AND Tissue category (RNA): any / Detected in some
understanding: The user is looking for genes that are classified as transcription factors and have expression limited to a restricted subset of tissues (more than one, but well under a third of tissues, corresponding to the HPA RNA tissue distribution categories such as 'Group enriched' or 'Tissue enhanced' / low tissue distribution in 'Tissue category (RNA)').

trail.why: Selecting the class 'Transcription factors' filters for all transcription factors without restricting to any specific DNA-binding domain subclass.

trail.requirement: expressed in only a handful of tissues, more than one but well under a third
trail.why: "Detected in some" is defined as being detected in more than one but fewer than a third of tissues, matching the requirement without restricting to a specific tissue.

requirements.why: The schema provides the 'Transcription factors' class under the 'Protein class' field.

requirements.requirement: expressed in only a handful of tissues, more than one but well under a third
requirements.why: In the HPA schema, 'Tissue category (RNA)' defines categories of RNA specificity and distribution across the 36 tissues, allowing selection of genes expressed/enriched in a restricted group of tissues (e.g., group enriched or detected in many/some tissues).
